notes: Patch notes: a What's new button sits in the footer, and Settings has a row for it. Every version is listed, newest first.
After an over-the-air update the sheet opens once by itself, so a new version says what changed instead of just being newer.
A new launcher icon: a note card with a folded corner on a violet field, with an adaptive, a round and a themed version for Android.

history.title: The line above the note keeps up
notes: The title line above a note follows the title, the word count and the reading time as you type.

history.title: Creating the Vault is one form
notes: Creating the Vault is one form: type the PIN, type it again, done, instead of two dialogs in a row that could lose the second half.

history.title: The first release
notes: Notes with markdown, folders, tags, [[links]] with backlinks, a graph, and search on Ctrl+K.
A Vault behind a PIN you choose, encrypted on the device, that locks itself and can change its PIN.
Export everything to one file, carry it as a code, import it back.
Offline first, and it can be installed to a home screen.
